scenario_1_refrigerant_leak.summary: Anomaly driven primarily by Temp Rise (85%)

prescription.impact: Cooling efficiency down ~40%, unit running but not cooling
prescription.action: Dispatch technician with refrigerant recharge kit and leak detector

scenario_2_fan_failure.summary: Anomaly driven by Fan RPM (48%) and Compressor Power (26%)

prescription.fault: Condenser Fan Motor Degradation or Failure
prescription.impact: Heat dissipation failure, compressor overload risk

scenario_3_compressor_wear.summary: Anomaly driven by Compressor Power (62%) and Temp Rise (30%)

prescription.impact: Progressive efficiency loss, full failure imminent
